verdict.summary: Round 1's major finding is resolved. The analyzer now computes structured TP/FP/FN abstention statistics for both arms, reports precision and recall, treats increased false-positive abstention rate or lower defined precision as a KILL 3 quality regression, and excludes that capability from adoption. The new synthetic regression test exercises the previously missed case: trap recall improves and ordinary mean accuracy remains unchanged while treatment adds false-positive abstentions; it verifies KILL 3 fires and adoption is refused. The complete synthetic analyzer suite passes (19 tests). No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issues were found in the diff.
